content:
The first poem I recited live in PACH …dedicated to one of my favourites..

This goes to you Anup Bhaiya

In a complex class when the polymorphism of equations made our brains numb!

These were the words that acted as the card of stump …

“Maana ki logon ne humpar baht atyaachaar kiye hain.. par hum jhel lenge” :D:D

In an ad-hoc photo session in a shut down marketplace ..

” Jab hum photo mein hain to background ko kaun dekhega”

The person who lifts from within you the air of despair..

With his pro cum PACH flair..

Inspired a CS HATER to be a creative geek,

This is my version of your PACH lead..

There may be many people who make you feel good about themselves,

The ones of whom you instantly become fans..

But there are very few who make you love yourself..

and My ANUP BHAIYA is one of them .. 🙂 🙂
